title: StructuralHealth SensorVibrationPanel

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Structural Health Sensor Vibration Panel research task. Generated synthetic sensor data matching real-world patterns, performed comprehensive vibration analysis across 5 assets and 3 zones over 90 days, identified ASSET_004 as high-risk with 80% degradation trend, created 6 analytical figures, and produced maintenance recommendations using simulated LLM based on quantitative results. All deliverables including code, outputs, and comprehensive report are complete.
